question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Affliction
solution: The correct answer is **"Consolation."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Affliction"** means a cause of pain or harm. (दुख, वेदना, मनस्‍ताप) • **Example**: *Malnutrition is one of the common **afflictions**__ of the poor.* • The antonym of **Affliction** is **Consolation**. • **"Consolation"** means a thing or person that makes you feel better when you are sad. (दिलासा देने या धैर्य बँधाने वाली वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति; सांत्‍वना) __ • **Example**:* After losing the match, the coach offered words of **consolation**__ to the disappointed players.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, Predicament,** means a difficult or unpleasant situation. (अप्रिय और कठिन स्थिति जिससे बाहर निकलना कठिन हो) • **Option 2, Mortgage, **is a noun that means a loan for purchasing property, usually a house. (संपत्ति खरीदने के लिए ऋण, आमतौर पर एक घर) • **Option 3, Jeopardy,** means danger or risk of harm or loss. (हानि या हानि का ख़तरा या ख़तरा) 43:Tdc8, The correct answer is **"My friend had already booked the tickets."**
